request: Design a fixation rod mounted from the top with arm length 200mm to have ability to fix cutting product

actions.target: Top geometry of the existing model
actions.relational_constraint: The fixation rod must be mounted from the top.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify which top face, surface, or feature of the existing CAD model is the mounting geometry and determine the intended mounting location on it.
steps: Use the semantic orientation defined in model.json: the top of the part is the +Y side with confidence 0.84. Localize the new rod to section R03, Upper interface head, rather than to the bottom mounting flange or broad front and back faces.
Use the raised cylindrical boss F009 as the top mounting feature. Select FACE 6, the planar boss end annulus at CAD y=180 mm with outward normal +Y, as the mounting and sketch-reference plane.

Locate the rod axis concentrically with the existing axial boss bore F010 and its cylindrical wall FACE 29. Constrain the axis to CAD coordinates x=67.5 mm and z=-21 mm and orient it parallel to CAD Y.
Create the fixation rod as a separate solid or assembly component so that it remains an insertable and adjustable member rather than becoming fused to SOLID 0.
On FACE 6, or on a datum plane coincident with FACE 6, sketch the circular rod profile concentric with FACE 29. The existing bore radius is 7.0175 mm, giving a reported bore diameter of 14.035 mm.

Because the rod diameter, fit, and thread specification are not supplied, define the shank diameter as a parameter. For a sliding rod, select a diameter slightly below 14.035 mm with suitable manufacturing clearance. If the visually suggested internal thread is confirmed, replace the smooth shank interface with a matching external thread using the specified nominal size, pitch, class, and engagement length; do not infer thread pitch from the images alone.

Extrude or revolve the rod profile along the bore centerline in the -Y insertion direction, representing installation from above the +Y boss end. Set the total rod arm length along its centerline to exactly 200 mm and define the length from the selected rod reference end or shoulder consistently.

Provide sufficient upper-end projection above FACE 6 for installation and adjustment. If a hand knob, wrench flat, transverse handle, or locking nut is required, create it as an additional revolved or extruded feature at the +Y end; its dimensions remain design parameters because no operating-head geometry was specified.

Form the lower end as the product-contacting fixation tip. Use a planar, rounded, or replaceable swivel-pad end according to the cutting-product surface, and add a small edge chamfer or fillet to remove sharp edges. The tip geometry and contact-pad diameter remain unresolved until the product shape and allowable clamping pressure are known.

Position the rod so its lower end can advance from the axial bore toward the open hook and cradle clearance F005 in section R02, allowing it to press the cutting product against the cradle support region without cutting or modifying the existing cradle faces.

Check the complete 200 mm motion envelope against the upper head, curved upright, open cradle, and mounting base. Confirm that the rod passes through FACE 29 without interference, reaches the intended product-contact zone, and does not collide with the bracket when adjusted through its required working range.

Add a retention or locking method appropriate to the selected interface, such as the confirmed screw thread and locknut, a split clamp, or a cross-pin arrangement. The opposed lateral holes F014 and F015 are existing pin interfaces, but they should only be incorporated into rod retention if their intended relationship to the new rod is verified.

Apply only modest lead-in chamfers to the rod insertion end and exposed edges. Preserve the existing boss end annulus FACE 6, axial bore wall FACE 29, boss outer wall FACE 5, boss shoulder blends, lateral holes, and structural upright unless a later fit or thread specification explicitly requires machining them.

Validate the final model as an assembly or multi-solid design: the original bracket remains one unchanged connected solid, the fixation rod is a new movable component, the rod centerline is coaxial with F010, the modeled arm length is 200 mm, and the insertion direction is from the semantic top toward -Y.

intention: Enable fixation of the cutting product.
